title: AI-Driven Anomaly Detection in Oscilloscope Images for Post-Silicon Validation
problem: In the post-silicon validation process, different functionalities and boundaries of a system-on-chip (SoC) are tested, generating a large amount of data in the form of oscilloscope images, trace data, and log files
motivation: ze and analyze the digital I/O signals and play a crucial role in detecting anomalies. However, the debugging process of the oscilloscope images requi
method: The approach trains a Convolutional Autoencoder (CAE)—a neural network that learns to compress and reconstruct images—on real silicon test data from various post-silicon validation projects. During training, the autoencoder learns to replicate normal oscilloscope images seen during testing. When presented with new test images, the autoencoder attempts to reconstruct them; if the reconstruction significantly differs from the original, that difference indicates an anomaly requiring investigation.
key_novelty: Using reconstruction error in a Convolutional Autoencoder to identify anomalies in post-silicon validation oscilloscope images.
limitations: Manual effort required in prior approaches
